title: F&B Controller
description:
**Job Description**
Job Summary:
  
  
The F&B Controller will be responsible for monitoring food and beverage costs, controlling inventory, analysing consumption, and ensuring efficient cost management across all restaurants, bars, kitchens, and other F&B operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor food and beverage costs, consumption, and operational expenses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly cost reports and MIS.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and physical stock audits.
* Analyse food costs, beverage costs, wastage, and variances.
* Monitor purchase prices, vendor rates, and adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef, F&B Operations, Stores, Purchase, and Finance teams.
* Ensure proper control over stock receipts, issues, transfers, and consumption.
* Verify recipe costing, portion control, and menu profitability.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and audit requirements.

**Job Expectations**
Strong knowledge of food and beverage costing, inventory management, and stock audits.
  
  
**Minimum Qualification**
Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
  
  
**Minimum Job Experience**
5–8 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control
  
  
**Reporting To**
Finance Head
  
  
**Travel**
NA Apply Now

title: Finance Controller
description:
We are seeking a skilled Finance Controller to join our team in Maharashtra. The Finance Controller will play a crucial role in overseeing the financial operations of the organization, ensuring that all financial practices are in line with statutory regulations and internal policies. This position requires a strong understanding of financial management, cost control, and treasury functions. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and implement financial strategies to support the organization's goals. - Monitor and analyze financial performance, providing insights and recommendations to senior management. - Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. - Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards. - Manage cash flow and treasury operations to optimize liquidity. - Collaborate with other departments to ensure financial alignment and support business objectives. - Lead and mentor the finance team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional development. Required Skills: - Proven experience as a Finance Controller or similar role. - Strong knowledge of financial regulations and accounting principles. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Excel. - Strong communication and leadership abilities. - Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. If you are a results-driven finance professional with a passion for excellence, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:
**What You'll Do** 




 o Implement financial strategies, policies, and procedures to support the organization's financial objectives and ensure compliance with regulations.
 



 o Assist in the day\-to\-day financial operations of the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
 



 o Monitor and analyze financial performance, identify areas of improvement, and provide recommendations to optimize the organization's financial resources.
 



 o Prepare and present financial statements, reports, and analysis to the management team and key stakeholders.
 



 o Manage cash flow, working capital, and liquidity to ensure the organization 's financial stability and growth.
 



 o Implement effective internal controls to safeguard assets, manage risks, and ensure accuracy and integrity of financial transactions and records.
 



 o Coordinate external audits, tax filings, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
 



 o Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and changes in financial regulations to ensure the organization's financial practices are in line with the latest standards.
 



  
 



**Skills/Qualifications** 




 o Minimum 3\+ years’ experience in financial management
 



 o Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field. A master's degree or professional certification such as CA (Chartered Accountant) are desirable.
 



 o Proven experience in financial management, accounting, or related roles.
 



 o Strong knowledge of financial principles, practices, and regulations, including GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles).
 



 o Proficiency in financial analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and financial modelling.
 



 o Excellent understanding of financial statements, financial ratios, and key performance indicators (KPIs)
 



 o Experience in managing cash flow, working capital, and financial risk.
 



 o Proficiency in using financial software and tools for data analysis and reporting.
 



 o Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.
 



 o Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities.
 



 o Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present financial information to non\-financial stakeholders.
 



 o Capacity to collaborate and coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
 



 o Attention to detail, accuracy, and integrity in financial reporting and record\-keeping.
 



 o Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment, adapting to changing priorities and deadlines
 



 o Experience in legal / financial services / insurance industry is preferred.
